definitions.explanation: Describes something that displays many different colors or varieties. Creates a vivid, vibrant image.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}とりどりの{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: Flowers of many colors are blooming.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}とりどりの{紅葉|こうよう}がきれいだった。
examples.english: The colorful autumn leaves were beautiful.

examples.japanese: テーブルには{色|いろ}とりどりの{料理|りょうり}が{並|なら}んでいた。
examples.english: A colorful array of dishes was lined up on the table.

notes:
{色|いろ}とりどり describes a vivid variety of colors or types. Used as a no-adjective ({色|いろ}とりどりの〜) or na-adjective ({色|いろ}とりどりな〜), with the の form being more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色|いろ}とりどりの{花|はな} (colorful flowers)
- {色|いろ}とりどりの{紅葉|こうよう} (colorful autumn leaves)
- {色|いろ}とりどりの{野菜|やさい} (colorful vegetables)
- {色|いろ}とりどりの{衣装|いしょう} (colorful costumes)

USAGE: While literally about color, it can also suggest variety and diversity in a broader sense. Always carries a positive, visually rich connotation.
